primitives.name: Ball 3D Localization from Single Image
primitives.verbatim_quote: In this work, we propose to address the task on a single image from a calibrated monocular camera by estimating ball diameter in pixels and use the knowledge of real ball diameter in meters.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'d_{\\text{pix}}': 'ball diameter in pixels', 'd_{\\text{m}}': 'real ball diameter in meters', 'K': 'camera intrinsic matrix'}
primitives.assumptions: Camera is calibrated; ball is visible in image; known real-world ball diameter.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Ball fully occluded or not visible in image.

layer2.mapping: Neural network estimates d_pix from image patches; K and d_m map to 3D coordinates via pinhole projection.
layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error between predicted and true 3D ball positions.

primitives.name: Neural Ball Diameter Estimator
primitives.verbatim_quote: To achieve this, we use a small neural network trained on image patches around candidates generated by a conventional ball detector.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x_i': 'image patch centered on ball candidate', 'y_i': 'predicted ball diameter in pixels', 'C': 'ball detector output'}
primitives.assumptions: Training data includes annotated image patches; ball candidates are generated by BallSeg.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Image patch lacks sufficient texture or ball visibility.

layer2.mapping: Neural network maps image patches x_i to estimated diameters y_i, aligning with ball detection confidence scores.
layer2.telemetry: Confidence score from network output for filtering false positives.
